## Objective

Add reproducible owner-routed preparation for all required local runtimes.

## Scope

- Runtime inventory
- Memory backend
- Standards/inference
- Ontology semantic profile

## Entry conditions

- Operational lifecycle and scope/grant gates exist.

## Exit criteria

- Each runtime has a pinned preparation, verification and recovery route.
- Unsupported host or missing resources yield a specific incomplete result.

## Risks

- Existing profiles are host-specific; no new-platform support is inferred.
- Configuration changes can invalidate certificates and indexes.

## TASK-013 - Implement supported runtime inventory and preparation

Add a reviewed runtime preparation adapter that verifies/reuses compatible resources or prepares isolated required resources under the selected full operation.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-012, REQ-014, REQ-025 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/scripts/init_runtime.py (proposed), SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/scripts/init_operational.py (proposed), SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/tests/test_full_operational_setup.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-012 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Do not copy environments/models from a project into the Template or replace the existing root .venv.

### Acceptance criteria

- Runtime receipts bind interpreter, host, pinned manifests/model artifacts, context and version checks; a local .venv directory is not required merely by convention.
- Missing resources/download authority, unsupported confinement/platform or interrupted preparation leaves a recoverable named blocker and preserves existing environments.

### Planned verification

- Test declared compatible reuse, absent/unsupported resources and interrupted preparation with narrow controlled fixtures.
- On the selected supported host later in Phase 9, verify actual prepared resources and isolated-reader/launcher compatibility.

| Dependencies | TASK-013 |

### Risks

- The current profile is macOS arm64/Python 3.12; another host needs reviewed artifact resolution, not guessed compatibility.

### Acceptance criteria

- The reviewed profile's mandatory certification and owner grant checks remain required; config changes are followed by the correct reindex and enabled-root query.
- Current canonical source coverage and profile/model/database hashes bind the result; lexical fallback is reported as a limitation, not hybrid success.

### Planned verification

- Run focused adapter/reindex/recovery regressions for changed config, corpus and failed publication.
- Plan and execute the actual selected-host pilot/certification and hybrid query as part of the integrated journey, recording its real result.
